text:
nidhi: Heads up — Citrine's customer finetune (citrine-v1-lora) landed in staging last night. Quick eval pack shows weird token repetition and a small instruction-following regression when we run the int4 quantized variant.
ben: Can you drop the eval link/artifact?
nidhi: https://artifacts.redwood/citrine/qep/495876 — results + logs are there. TL;DR: int4 > fp16 has ~6% drop on InstrBench and some examples with repeated tokens mid-answer.
sam: I pulled the logs and re-ran locally. Repro steps I used:
```
# quick local smoke run
./tools/qeval --model citrine-v1-lora --quant int4 --batch 1 --prompts tests/instr/sample_set.json --out results.json
```
Outputs show perplexity up ~1.8 and token-replication on long responses (~>200 tokens).
joel: Tokenizer mismatch? Often repeats come from special-token remap issues after merges. Did the LoRA patch expect a different tokenizer config?
nidhi: Good catch — the LoRA was trained against base v2 tokenizer but we deployed model artifacts with base v1 tokenizer.json. Found mapping for <|sep|> -> 50256 in deployed tokenizer while adapter expects 1. I pushed a small remap script in the artifact folder.
sam: Also noticed KV-cache growth during generation (memory footprint spike). Hypothesis: adapter prepended persona tokens at merge time and our prefix-handling didn't strip them when building KV cache for quant path. That causes misaligned attention and repetition.
ci-bot: deploy-bot: Canary run completed. Canary used fallback to fp16 for 12% of requests due to quant instabilities; overall p95 latency OK. Flagged for triage label: quant-regress.
ben: Proposed plan: 1) Confirm tokenizer remap fixes token repetition. 2) Add a small inference shim to strip adapter-introduced prefix tokens before KV-caching for quant path. 3) Run quantization-aware calibration (PTQ with outlier clipping) and rerun QEP. 4) If still bad, fallback policy -> serve fp16 for customer queries until fixed.
joel: Quick checklist I suggest to keep track:
- reproduce locally with provided artifact (nidhi)
- run tokenizer-remap + re-eval (sam)
- run PTQ with calibrator on a heldout slice of customer prompts (ben)
- run long-form generation tests (>=512 tokens) to verify no mid-answer collapse (joel)
- push safe rollout that pins fp16 fallback for 24h (ci-bot)

nidhi: I already put the remap script at artifacts/scripts/remap_tokenizer.py — sample usage: 
```
python artifacts/scripts/remap_tokenizer.py \ 
  --tokenizer artifacts/tokenizer_v1.json \ 
  --mapping artifacts/token_mappings/lora_v2_remap.json \ 
  --out artifacts/tokenizer_patched.json
```
I'll attach patched tokenizer to the staging model after tests.
sam: For PTQ, try calibrator flags: `--clip-quant 0.01 --per-channel` and compare int4 acc with base fp16. Also try our fast-lsq fallback quant config `quant_profiles/fast_lsq.json`.
ben: If remap + cache-trim fixes the hallucination/repetition we can proceed with a limited canary (5% traffic) but keep checkout to rollback to fp16 automatically. Add an alert rule on InstrBench delta > 3%.
joel: Assigning tasks: @nidhi -> produce patched artifact and update staging by EOD. @sam -> run qeval + PTQ experiments tomorrow morning and post results to the artifact. @ben -> update rollout policy and alert. I'll coordinate canary once we have green smoke.
ci-bot: noted — created ticket INF-3421 and scheduled a canary gate: quant-regress-check.
ben: Thanks — looks good. Keep replies short here so we have an audit trail. :thumbsup:
